name: IBA Official Cocktail Recipes
title: IBA Official Cocktail Recipes
description: All 90 International Bartenders Association official cocktail recipes with ingredients, quantities, units, and preparation methods.

rows.name: Bellini
rows.method: Pour peach puree into the mixing glass with ice, add the Prosecco wine. Stir gently and pour in a chilled flute glass.  Note: PUCCINI - Fresh Mandarin Orange Juice; ROSSINI - Fresh Strawberry Puree; TINTORETTO - Fresh Pomegranate Juice.
rows.ingredients: 100 ml Prosecco: 100: ml: Prosecco, 50 ml White Peach Puree: 50: ml: White Peach Puree

rows.name: Black Russian
rows.method: Pour the ingredients into the old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes. Stir gently.  Note: WHITE RUSSIAN - Float fresh cream on the top and stir in slowly.
rows.ingredients: 50 ml Vodka: 50: ml: Vodka, 20 ml Coffee Liqueur: 20: ml: Coffee Liqueur

rows.name: Bloody Mary
rows.method: Stir gently all the ingredients in a mixing glass with ice, pour into rocks glass. Note: If requested served with ice, pour into highball glass.
rows.garnish: Celery, Lemon Wedge (Optional)
rows.ingredients: 45 ml Vodka: 45: ml: Vodka, 90 ml Tomato Juice: 90: ml: Tomato Juice, 15 ml Fresh Lemon Juice: 15: ml: Fresh Lemon Juice, 2 dashes Worcestershire Sauce: 2: dash: Worcestershire Sauce, Tabasco: 1: dash: Tabasco, Celery Salt: 1: dash: Celery Salt, Pepper (Up to taste): 1: dash: Pepper: Up to taste

rows.name: Caipirinha
rows.method: Place lime and sugar into a double old fashioned glass and muddle gently. Fill the glass with cracked ice and add Cachaça. Stir gently to involve ingredients. Note: CAIPIROSKA - Instead of Cachaça use Vodka;
rows.ingredients: 60 ml Cachaça: 60: ml: Cachaça, 1 Lime cut into small wedges: 1: piece: Lime cut into small wedges, 4 Teaspoons White Cane Sugar: 4: teaspoon: White Cane Sugar

rows.name: Champagne Cocktail
rows.method: Place the sugar cube with 2 dashes of bitters in a large Champagne glass, add the cognac. Pour gently chilled Champagne.
rows.garnish: Garnish with orange zest and maraschino cherry.
rows.ingredients: 90 ml Chilled Champagne: 90: ml: Chilled Champagne, 10 ml Cognac: 10: ml: Cognac, 2 dashes Angostura bitters: 2: dash: Angostura bitters, Few drops of Grand Marnier (optional): few: drops: Grand Marnier: optional, 1 sugar cube: 1: piece: Sugar Cube

rows.name: Corpse Reviver #2
rows.method: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice. Shake well and strain in chilled cocktail glass.
rows.garnish: Garnish with orange zest
rows.ingredients: 30 ml Gin: 30: ml: Gin, 30 ml Cointreau: 30: ml: Cointreau, 30 ml Lillet Blanc: 30: ml: Lillet Blanc, 30 ml Fresh Lemon Juice: 30: ml: Fresh Lemon Juice, 1 dash Absinthe: 1: dash: Absinthe

rows.name: Cosmopolitan
rows.method: Add all ingredients into a cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake well and strain into a large cocktail glass.
rows.garnish: Garnish with a lemon twist.
rows.ingredients: 40 ml Vodka Citron: 40: ml: Vodka Citron, 15 ml Cointreau: 15: ml: Cointreau, 15 ml Fresh Lime Juice: 15: ml: Fresh Lime Juice, 30 ml Cranberry Juice: 30: ml: Cranberry Juice

rows.name: Cuba Libre
rows.method: Build all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.
rows.garnish: Garnish with lime wedge.
rows.ingredients: 50 ml White Rum: 50: ml: White Rum, 120 ml Coca Cola: 120: ml: Coca Cola, 10 ml Fresh Lime Juice: 10: ml: Fresh Lime Juice

rows.name: French 75
rows.method: Pour all the ingredients, except Champagne, into a shaker. Shake well and strain into a Champagne flute. Top up with Champagne. Stir gently.
rows.ingredients: 30 ml Gin: 30: ml: Gin, 15 ml Fresh Lemon Juice: 15: ml: Fresh Lemon Juice, 15 ml Sugar Syrup: 15: ml: Sugar Syrup, 60 ml Champagne: 60: ml: Champagne

rows.name: French Connection
rows.method: Pour all ingredients directly into an old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes. Stir gently.
rows.ingredients: 35 ml Cognac: 35: ml: Cognac, 35 ml Amaretto: 35: ml: Amaretto

rows.name: Golden Dream
rows.method: Pour all ingredients into shaker filled with ice. Shake briskly for few seconds. Strain into chilled cocktail glass.
rows.ingredients: 20 ml Galliano: 20: ml: Galliano, 20 ml Triple Sec: 20: ml: Triple Sec, 20 ml Fresh Orange Juice: 20: ml: Fresh Orange Juice, 10 ml Fresh Cream: 10: ml: Fresh Cream

rows.name: Grasshopper
rows.method: Pour all ingredients into shaker filled with ice. Shake briskly for few seconds. Strain into chilled cocktail glass.
rows.garnish: N/A, optional mint leaf
rows.ingredients: 20 ml Crème de Cacao (White): 20: ml: Crème de Cacao: White, 20 ml Crème de Menthe (Green): 20: ml: Crème de Menthe: Green, 20 ml Fresh Cream: 20: ml: Fresh Cream

rows.name: Hemingway Special
rows.method: Pour all ingredients into a shaker with ice. Shake well and strain into a large cocktail glass.
rows.ingredients: 60 ml Rum: 60: ml: Rum, 40 ml Grapefruit Juice: 40: ml: Grapefruit Juice, 15 ml Maraschino Luxardo: 15: ml: Maraschino Luxardo, 15 ml Fresh Lime: 15: ml: Fresh Lime

rows.name: Horse's Neck
rows.method: Pour Cognac and ginger ale directly into a highball glass with ice cubes. Stir gently. If preferred, add dashes of Angostura Bitter.
rows.garnish: Garnish with a rind of one lemon spiral.
rows.ingredients: 40 ml Cognac: 40: ml: Cognac, 120 ml Ginger Ale: 120: ml: Ginger Ale, Dash of Angostura Bitters (optional): 1: dash: Angostura Bitters: optional

rows.name: Irish Coffee
rows.method: Warm black coffee is poured into a pre-heated Irish coffee glass. Whiskey and at least one teaspoon of sugar is added and stirred until dissolved. Fresh thick chilled cream is carefully poured over the back of a spoon held just above the surface of the coffee. The layer of cream will float on the coffee without mixing. Plain sugar can be replaced with sugar syrup
rows.ingredients: 50 ml Irish Whiskey: 50: ml: Irish Whiskey, 120 ml Hot coffee: 120: ml: Hot coffee, 50 ml Fresh cream (Chilled): 50: ml: Fresh cream: Chilled, 1 teaspoon Sugar: 1: teaspoon: Sugar

rows.name: KIR
rows.method: Pour Crème de Cassis into glass, top up with white wine. Note: KIR ROYAL - Use Champagne instead of white wine
rows.ingredients: 90 ml Dry White Wine: 90: ml: Dry White Wine, 10 ml Crème de Cassis: 10: ml: Crème de Cassis

rows.name: Long Island Ice Tea
rows.method: Add all ingredients into a highball glass filled with ice. Stir gently.
rows.garnish: Lemon Slice (Optional)
rows.ingredients: 15 ml Vodka: 15: ml: Vodka, 15 ml Tequila: 15: ml: Tequila, 15 ml White rum: 15: ml: White rum, 15 ml Gin: 15: ml: Gin, 15 ml Cointreau: 15: ml: Cointreau, 30 ml Lemon juice: 30: ml: Lemon juice, 20 ml Simple syrup: 20: ml: Simple syrup, Top with Cola: 1: top up: Cola

rows.name: Mai-Tai
rows.method: Add all ingredients into a shaker with ice. Shake and pour into a double rocks glass or a highball glass.  The Martinique molasses rum used by Trader Vic was not an Agricole rum but a type of “rummy” from molasses.
rows.garnish: Garnish with pineapple spear, mint leaves, and lime peel.
rows.ingredients: 30 ml Amber Jamaican Rum: 30: ml: Amber Jamaican Rum, 30 ml Martinique Molasses Rhum: 30: ml: Martinique Molasses Rhum, 15 ml Orange Curacao: 15: ml: Orange Curacao, 15 ml Orgeat Syrup (Almond): 15: ml: Orgeat Syrup: Almond, 30 ml Fresh Lime Juice: 30: ml: Fresh Lime Juice, 7.5 ml Simple Syrup: 7.5: ml: Simple Syrup

rows.name: Margarita
rows.method: Add all ingredients into a shaker with ice. Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass
rows.garnish: Half salt rim (Optional)
rows.ingredients: 50 ml Tequila 100% Agave: 50: ml: Tequila 100% Agave, 20 ml Triple Sec: 20: ml: Triple Sec, 15 ml Freshly Squeezed Lime Juice: 15: ml: Freshly Squeezed Lime Juice

rows.name: Mimosa
rows.method: Pour orange juice into a flute glass and gently pour the sparkling wine. Stir gently. Note: Also known as Buck's Fizz.
rows.garnish: Garnish with an orange twist (optional).
rows.ingredients: 75 ml Fresh orange juice: 75: ml: Fresh orange juice, 75 ml Prosecco: 75: ml: Prosecco

rows.name: Mint Julep
rows.method: In Julep Stainless Steel Cup gently muddle the mint with sugar and water. Fill the glass with cracked ice, add the Bourbon and stir well until the cup frosts.
rows.garnish: Garnish with a mint sprig.
rows.ingredients: 60 ml Bourbon Whiskey: 60: ml: Bourbon Whiskey, 4 fresh Mint sprigs: 4: piece: fresh Mint sprigs, 1 tsp Powdered Sugar: 1: teaspoon: Powdered Sugar, 2 tsp Water: 2: teaspoon: Water

rows.name: Mojito
rows.method: Mix mint springs with sugar and lime juice. Add splash of soda water and fill the glass with ice. Pour the rum and top with soda water. Light stir to involve all ingredients.
rows.garnish: Garnish with sprigs of mint and slice of lime.
rows.ingredients: 45 ml White Cuban Ron: 45: ml: White Cuban Ron, 20 ml Fresh Lime Juice: 20: ml: Fresh Lime Juice, 6 pcs Mint Sprigs: 6: piece: Mint Sprigs, 2 tsp White Cane Sugar: 2: teaspoon: White Cane Sugar, Soda Water: 1: top up: Soda Water

rows.name: Moscow Mule
rows.method: In a Mule Cup or rocks glass, combine the vodka and ginger beer. Add lime juice and gently stir to involve all ingredients.
rows.garnish: Garnish with a lime slice
rows.ingredients: 45 ml Smirnoff Vodka: 45: ml: Smirnoff Vodka, 120 ml Ginger Beer: 120: ml: Ginger Beer, 10 ml Fresh lime juice: 10: ml: Fresh lime juice

rows.name: Pina Colada
rows.method: Blend all the ingredients with ice in an electric blender, pour into a large glass, and serve with straws.  Note: Historically a few drops of fresh lime juice were added to taste. 4 slices of fresh pineapple can be used instead of juice
rows.garnish: Garnish with a slice of pineapple with a cocktail cherry.
rows.ingredients: 50 ml White Rum: 50: ml: White Rum, 30 ml Coconut Cream: 30: ml: Coconut Cream, 50 ml Fresh Pineapple Juice: 50: ml: Fresh Pineapple Juice

rows.name: Pisco Sour
rows.method: Add all ingredients into a shaker with ice. Shake and strain into a chilled goblet glass.
rows.garnish: Few dashes of Amargo bitters on top as an aromatic garnish.
rows.ingredients: 60 ml Pisco: 60: ml: Pisco, 30 ml Fresh Lemon Juice: 30: ml: Fresh Lemon Juice, 20 ml Simple Syrup: 20: ml: Simple Syrup, 1 Raw Egg White: 1: piece: Raw Egg White

rows.name: Sea Breeze
rows.method: Build all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.
rows.garnish: Garnish with orange zest and cherry
rows.ingredients: 40 ml Vodka: 40: ml: Vodka, 120 ml Cranberry Juice: 120: ml: Cranberry Juice, 30 ml Grapefruit Juice: 30: ml: Grapefruit Juice

rows.name: Sex on the Beach
rows.method: Build all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.
rows.garnish: Garnish with a half orange slice.
rows.ingredients: 40 ml Vodka: 40: ml: Vodka, 20 ml Peach Schnapps: 20: ml: Peach Schnapps, 40 ml Fresh Orange Juice: 40: ml: Fresh Orange Juice, 40 ml Cranberry Juice: 40: ml: Cranberry Juice

rows.name: Singapore Sling
rows.method: Pour all ingredients into a cocktail shaker filled with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain into Hurricane glass.
rows.garnish: Garnish with pineapple and maraschino cherry
rows.ingredients: 30 ml Gin: 30: ml: Gin, 15 ml Cherry liqueur: 15: ml: Cherry liqueur, 7.5 ml Cointreau: 7.5: ml: Cointreau, 7.5 ml DOM Bénédictine: 7.5: ml: DOM Bénédictine, 120 ml Fresh Pineapple Juice: 120: ml: Fresh Pineapple Juice, 15 ml Fresh Lime Juice: 15: ml: Fresh Lime Juice, 10 ml Grenadine Syrup: 10: ml: Grenadine Syrup, A dash of Angostura bitters: 1: dash: Angostura bitters

rows.name: Tequila Sunrise
rows.method: Pour tequila and orange juice directly into highball glass filled with ice cubes. Add the grenadine syrup to create chromatic effect (sunrise), do not stir.
rows.garnish: Garnish with half orange slice or an orange zest
rows.ingredients: 45 ml Tequila: 45: ml: Tequila, 90 ml Fresh Orange Juice: 90: ml: Fresh Orange Juice, 15 ml Grenadine Syrup: 15: ml: Grenadine Syrup

rows.name: Vesper
rows.method: Pour all ingredients into a cocktail shaker filled with ice cubes. Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
rows.garnish: Lemon zest
rows.ingredients: 45 ml Gin: 45: ml: Gin, 15 ml Vodka: 15: ml: Vodka, 7.5 ml Lillet Blanc: 7.5: ml: Lillet Blanc

rows.name: Zombie
rows.method: Add all ingredients into an electric blender with 170 grams of cracked ice. With pulse bottom blend for a few seconds. Serve in a tall tumbler glass.  Note: Donn's Mix: 2 parts of fresh yellow grapefruit and 1 part of cinnamon syrup
rows.garnish: Garnish with mint leaves.
rows.ingredients: 45 ml Jamaican dark rum: 45: ml: Jamaican dark rum, 45 ml Gold Puerto Rican rum: 45: ml: Gold Puerto Rican rum, 30 ml Demerara Rum: 30: ml: Demerara Rum, 20 ml Fresh lime juice: 20: ml: Fresh lime juice, 15 ml Falernum: 15: ml: Falernum, 15 ml Donn's Mix: 15: ml: Donn's Mix, 1 tsp Grenadine syrup: 1: teaspoon: Grenadine syrup, 1 dash Angostura bitters: 1: dash: Angostura bitters, 6 drops Pernod: 6: drops: Pernod

rows.name: Barracuda
rows.method: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker except the Prosecco, shake well with ice, strain into chilled highball glass filled with ice and top up with Prosecco.
rows.garnish: Pineapple and Cherry, optional mint sprig for additional aroma.
rows.ingredients: 45 ml Gold Rum: 45: ml: Gold Rum, 15 ml Galliano: 15: ml: Galliano, 60 ml Fresh Pineapple Juice: 60: ml: Fresh Pineapple Juice, 1 dash Fresh Lime Juice: 1: dash: Fresh Lime Juice, Top up with Prosecco: 1: top up: Prosecco

rows.name: Bee's Knees
rows.method: Stir honey with lemon and orange juices until it dissolves, add gin and shake with ice. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
rows.garnish: Optionally garnish with a lemon or orange zest.
rows.ingredients: 52.5 ml Dry Gin: 52.5: ml: Dry Gin, 2 teaspoons Honey Syrup: 2: teaspoon: Honey Syrup, 22.5 ml Fresh Lemon Juice: 22.5: ml: Fresh Lemon Juice, 22.5 ml Fresh Orange Juice: 22.5: ml: Fresh Orange Juice

rows.name: Bramble
rows.method: Pour all ingredients into a cocktail shaker except the Crème de Mûre, shake well with ice, strain into chilled old fashioned glass filled with crushed ice, then pour the blackberry liqueur (Crème de Mûre) over the top of the drink, in a circular motion.
rows.garnish: Garnish optionally with a lemon slice and blackberries.
rows.ingredients: 50 ml Gin: 50: ml: Gin, 25 ml Fresh Lemon Juice: 25: ml: Fresh Lemon Juice, 12.5 ml Sugar Syrup: 12.5: ml: Sugar Syrup, 15 ml Crème de Mûre: 15: ml: Crème de Mûre

rows.name: Canchanchara
rows.method: Mix honey with water and lime juice and spread the mixture on the bottom and sides of the glass. Add cracked ice, and then the rum. End by energetically stirring from bottom to top.
rows.garnish: Lime wedge.
rows.ingredients: 60 ml Cuban Aguardiente: 60: ml: Cuban Aguardiente, 15 ml Fresh Lime Juice: 15: ml: Fresh Lime Juice, 15 ml Raw Honey: 15: ml: Raw Honey, 50 ml Water: 50: ml: Water

rows.name: Dark ‘n' stormy
rows.method: In a highball glass filled with ice pour the ginger beer and top floating with the Rum.
rows.garnish: Garnish with a lime wedge or slice.
rows.ingredients: 60 ml Goslings Rum: 60: ml: Goslings Rum, 100 ml Ginger Beer: 100: ml: Ginger Beer

rows.name: Espresso Martini
rows.method: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.
rows.ingredients: 50 ml Vodka: 50: ml: Vodka, 30 ml Kahlúa: 30: ml: Kahlúa, 10 ml Sugar Syrup: 10: ml: Sugar Syrup, 1 strong Espresso: 1: shot: strong Espresso

rows.name: Fernandito
rows.method: Pour the Fernet Branca into a double old fashioned glass with ice, fill the glass up with Cola. Gently stir.
rows.ingredients: 50 ml Fernet Branca: 50: ml: Fernet Branca, Fill up with Cola: 1: fill up: Cola

rows.name: Naked and Famous

rows.method: Poor the tequila into a highball glass, squeeze the lime juice. Add ice and salt, fill up pink grapefruit soda. Stir gently.
